title: Localization commutes with embedded-prime removal
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $M\to M'$ be the quotient supplied by [lem-sc-hilbert-embedded-points-affine-removal], and, for $f\in R$, let $M_f\to (M_f)'$ be the corresponding quotient for the localized module. Then $(M')_f\cong(M_f)'$.
